verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents inviting an external accountant or bookkeeper into Pilot with role-scoped permissions. The portal is described only for talking with Pilot's own team. The note that any tax preparer can work with your QuickBooks file relies on a host-platform capability, not a Pilot feature, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
